model: RegioArdo two-room controller (dampers, chilled beams, radiators)
equipment_type: Room controller (chilled beam, radiator, VAV damper)
applies_to: Regin RegioArdo 24 V AC pre-programmed two-room controllers for dampers, chilled beams and radiators, used with ED-RU room units.
summary: RegioArdo is a ceiling-void or DIN-rail room controller that can run two rooms independently, with heating, cooling, VAV, CO2, lighting, blinds and underfloor-heating functions. It talks EXOline, Modbus or BACnet MS/TP on its two RS485 ports and BACnet IP on Ethernet. The BACnet list is fixed and large because every function and both rooms have their own objects.
notes: Object list from Appendix D of the RegioArdo manual rev H (2023-09-19), pages 130-150. The newer rev I (2025) no longer prints the BACnet lists.
The manual lists only Multistate Value, Binary Value and Analog Value objects; the instance numbers are fixed (BV 1xxxx/2xxxx, AV and MV 3xxxx/4xxxx).
The BACnet table has no units column; units are left blank here (temperatures are °C).
Signals footnoted in the manual need firmware 2.0-1-04 or later (some alarm and underfloor-heating objects need 2.0-1-05).
Value objects are not commandable; the last write wins. Object names can be renamed from BACnet or Application tool.
Objects ending in Zone2 belong to the second room; AlaPt objects are the alarm points (status, delay, priority) of the built-in alarm list.

integration.summary: Select BACnet on the RS485 port (or BACnet IP on the Ethernet port) in Application tool, then command the unit state with RegioControllerStateRemote (MV 30010) and set the comfort setpoints. If the communication heartbeat is enabled, the BMS must keep writing RegioCommFailsafe (BV 10009). Read RegioControlState, RegioRoomTemp and the sum alarm for status. Room 2 has its own set of ...Zone2 objects.

minimum_points.name: RegioControllerStateRemote
minimum_points.why: Unit state command: off, unoccupied, standby, occupied

minimum_points.name: RegioFanSelect
minimum_points.why: Fan speed command: off, speed 1-3 or auto

minimum_points.name: RegioCommFailsafe
minimum_points.why: Heartbeat; write 1 to reset the failsafe timer

integration.enable: RegioControllerStateRemote (MV 30010) forces off, unoccupied, standby or occupied; 6 = no remote control hands control back to the controller's own logic.
integration.heartbeat: Optional communication heartbeat: when enabled (RegioEnableCommFailsafe, BV 10010) the BMS must set RegioCommFailsafe (BV 10009) to 1 within the failsafe time (default 10 min). If it doesn't, the controller goes to the configured failsafe state (RegioFailsafeState, MV 30182; default Off), raises an alarm and shows RegioCommFailsafeActive (BV 20099).
integration.remote_sensors: In the BACnet list only the underfloor temperature can come from the network: set RegioRemoteUnderfloorTempSelect (BV 10012) and write RegioRemoteUnderfloortemp (AV 30202). The BMS can also shift the setpoint with RegioSetPOffsetRemote (AV 30009).
setup: RS485 ports 1 and 2 support EXOline, Modbus or BACnet MS/TP; the Ethernet port supports BACnet IP (RegioBACnetIpEnable).
Protocol, MAC address and device ID are set in Application tool.
gotchas: With the heartbeat enabled, a BMS that stops writing BV 10009 puts the room into the failsafe state (Off by default).
Setpoints, P-band, I-time and alarm delays are stored settings; don't write them cyclically.
